species.name: Kokanee
why: Water 55°F on top, right in their comfort range.
Best water today is 44–50 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 40 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 65 ft, so fish stay above it.
